newsitem.title: USA: US spot products end firmer as NYMEX prices rally.
newsitem.headline: US spot products end firmer as NYMEX prices rally.

text.p: U.S. spot product prices ended stronger Monday as NYMEX futures prices rallied sharply and brisk trade in U.S. Gulf (USG) firmed gasoline differentials.
The jump in gasoline futures prices on the NYMEX led the complex higher, paring the early heating oil futures weakness and triggering active technical buying.
USG gasoline attracted the most attention Monday, players said, as paper trading narrowed the conventional unleaded M4 market spreads slightly.
"The market just gets moving and everyone hops on the bandwagon," one trader said. "It's a lot of hype and scare."
Prompt unleaded gasoline for the 34th cycle on the Colonial Pipeline traded as high as 0.25 cent under the NYMEX print, though most of the action took place slightly below that level.
M4 for the 35th cycle was put at about 2.40 cents under the screen, with the 34-35th cycle spread at 2.00 cents, while 36th cycle M4 was talked at about 3.40 cents under the NYMEX.
New York Harbor action remained subdued following the two-day NYMEX holiday, with many players squaring their books as the cash basis shifted to the January contract.
"This is a very confused market," one trader said.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
